name: LawAsked
tagline: Legal questions answered, with the statute behind each one.
description: LawAsked is a free legal information site that answers everyday legal questions country by country. Each of its 12 country sites (US, UK, Australia, Canada, Germany, Austria, France, Spain, the Netherlands, Norway, Sweden and Japan) is written from that country's own legislation, and every answer quotes and links the in-force sections it relies on. Coverage today focuses on employment, tenancy, consumer and small-claims questions. Answers are drafted with AI assistance from the official legal text and checked before publication so that every citation matches the statute. LawAsked is an information service, not a law firm.
